question: Each sibling has a 1 in 4 chance of matching a patient's tissue type exactly. With three siblings, what percentage chance of any match?
move: Chances of at least one success never simply add; multiply the failures instead.
ask: Where do I add chances of success that I should be multiplying the failures of?
trap: Adding 25% three times and arriving at 75%.
hint: Work out the chance that every one of the siblings fails to match.
steps: Chance one sibling does not match: 3/4.
Chance none of the three match: 3/4 x 3/4 x 3/4 = 27/64.
reference: Murphy & Weaver, Janeway's Immunobiology, 9th edition, Garland Science, 2016
